LanguageData.RHA_BladeTrial030_root.label: Meet the charge
LanguageData.RHA_BladeTrial030_root.description: Threat: An enemy locks a defended facing, reducing frontal damage by at most 20%. Answer: Attack the marked side or rear, or use existing control to break the stance. Reward: It takes 25% more damage for 8 seconds; the stance does not rebuild in that phase. Cost: Frontal attacks still kill, but miss the counter reward. Arrangement: Baited pursuit; Locked impact. New first clears teach counters; refinements deepen coordination. Roles change no faster than every 30 seconds. Locked attacks never track; ordinary attacks and early kills work. Existing finite roster retained.
